# 1 Enoch Chapter 87 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**1** And I saw one of those four white figures, that it came forth from that place and three were with it.

**2** And those three that had last come forth grasped me by my hand and took me up, away from the generations of the earth, and raised me up to a lofty place, and showed me a tower raised high above the earth, and all the hills were lower.

**3** And one said to me: "Remain here until you see everything that befalls those elephants, camels, and asses, and the stars and the oxen, and all of them."

**4** And I saw one of those four white figures, how he seized that first star which had fallen from heaven, and bound it hand and foot and cast it into an abyss; now that abyss was narrow and deep and horrible and dark.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Chapter 87 introduces the four archangels as 'white figures' — four beings of pure light. Three of them transport Enoch to an elevated vantage point from which he will observe the entire subsequent history of the world (the Animal Apocalypse continues in chs. 88-90). The binding of the first fallen star (v. 4) = the imprisonment of Semyaza, leader of the Watchers (cf. 1 En 10:11-13).*
